The film "Apollo 13" portrayed astronaut Swigert as unprepared for the flight, but this was untrue. Swigert was very familiar with the module as he had also long worked on developing it. The dialogue between ground control and the astronauts was taken nearly verbatim from transcripts and recordings, with the exception of the famous line "Houston, we have a problem." According to audio of the air-to-ground communications, the actual words uttered by Swigert were "Okay, Houston, we've had a problem here." In the actual re-entry, the Command Module's transmission was not met with a warm welcome as depicted in the film.

In Luke 3:23–38, the genealogy of Jesus is traced back to Adam, with the article tou repeating uiou (Son) except before Joseph. This genealogy descends from the Davidic line through Nathan, who is an otherwise little-known son of David. In the ancestry of David, Luke agrees completely with the Old Testament. Cainan is included between Arphaxad and Shelah, following the Septuagint text. Augustine notes that the count of generations in the Book of Luke is 77, a number symbolizing the forgiveness of all sins. This count also agrees with the seventy generations from Enoch set forth in the Book of Enoch.
